skirmish.module.rune_window.name: Rune Window
skirmish.module.rune_window.description: When your opponent pops a totem with the «Immortality» rune, a countdown of their invulnerability (3 s per the wiki) appears next to the crosshair so you don't waste hits. The rune is read from the totem in their hand; invisible players are never shown.
skirmish.module.rune_window.setting.use_: Show a countdown even if the opponent's totem couldn't be read before the pop (marked with «?»)
skirmish.module.rune_window.setting.fall: Seconds to count when the rune is unknown
skirmish.module.rune_window.setting.rest: Briefly show «FULL HP» when the opponent's restoration rune fires
skirmish.module.rune_window.setting.self: Also count down your own «Immortality» rune
skirmish.module.rune_window.setting.end_: A short sound only you hear when the invulnerability ends
